hooks.prompt:
Check whether a real decision, trade-off resolution, adopted assumption, or corrected earlier belief occurred THIS turn.
- If YES: invoke the reasoning-note skill and offer a one-paragraph note (why + rejected alternatives + one-line decision); if the WHY wasn't stated, ask for it rather than inventing one.
- If NO: output NOTHING AT ALL. No acknowledgement, no 'No action needed', no summary. Stay completely silent.
Only produce visible output when you are actually offering or writing a note.
If docs/reasoning/ exists, read the notes in it (all of them if they fit) so prior decisions and their rationale are in context before work begins.
